certificates.description: Certificates keyed by hostname, each the path to the certificate on the machine.

deployKey.description: Path to the public key the ocel-deploy login accepts. Left off, the bootstrapping login's keys.

perHostnamePreviewCertificates.description: Deploy previews even when each gets its own publicly logged certificate. Left off, those deploys are refused.

proxy.description: What fronts this machine on ports 80 and 443. Left off, ocel runs its own proxy.

traefik.description: A Traefik the machine already runs, reading ocel's routes from a watched directory.

containerDirectory.description: Where directory is mounted inside Traefik's container. Left off, directory itself.

directory.description: The directory Traefik's file provider watches, where ocel writes its routers.

entrypoints.description: The entry points ocel's routers attach to.

http.description: The entry point ocel's http-to-https redirect routers attach to. Left off, web.

https.description: The entry point ocel's hostname routers attach to. Left off, websecure.

entrypoints.title: Entrypoints

network.description: A docker network ocel's switchboard joins, so Traefik reaches it by name. Not with port.

port.description: The loopback port ocel's switchboard listens on for Traefik. Left off, 8480. Not with network.

preset.description: The host tool whose Traefik this is, which fills in the other fields. Fields set beside it override.

previewResolver.description: A resolver that issues the preview wildcard certificate over DNS-01. Left off, each preview gets its own certificate.

resolver.description: The certificate resolver every hostname router ocel writes names.

caddy.description: A Caddy the machine already runs, importing ocel's site blocks from a directory.

config.description: The config file caddy reload names inside the container. Left off, /etc/caddy/Caddyfile.

container.description: The container Caddy runs in. Left off, Caddy runs as the systemd caddy.service.

containerDirectory.description: Where directory is mounted inside Caddy's container. Left off, directory itself.

directory.description: The directory the running Caddy imports site blocks from.

network.description: A docker network ocel's switchboard joins, so Caddy reaches it by name. Not with port.

manual.description: A proxy you route to ocel yourself. ocel writes nothing to it.

network.description: A docker network ocel's switchboard joins, so your proxy reaches it by name.

port.description: The loopback port your proxy forwards to ocel's switchboard on. Left off, 8480.

ssh.description: The machine to deploy onto: a Host alias from ssh_config, or the destination spelled out.

host.description: The hostname or address to reach the machine at.

identityFile.description: The private key to authenticate with, as a path.

port.description: The port sshd listens on. Omit it and ssh's own default applies.

user.description: The account to log in as. Omit it and ssh resolves the user itself.
